# Knowledge Guide: Chinese Stock Market Corporate Database (`enq-cnds-cndv-ccks_stock`)

## 1. Business Context & Scope

This database serves as a comprehensive repository of Chinese A-share listed company information, covering corporate fundamentals, equity transactions, shareholder activities, market trading data, and regulatory filings. It supports analytical use cases across corporate governance, capital market events, industry classification, and financial performance assessment.

All table and column names are in Simplified Chinese. Field values follow conventions of the Chinese securities regulatory ecosystem (CSRC standards, Shanghai/Shenzhen stock exchange codes).

---

## 2. Core Entities & Field Definitions

### 2.1 Corporate Identity & Fundamentals

| Table | Business Purpose |
|-------|-----------------|
| `公司概况` | Master company profile: stock codes, registered names, board secretary contacts, incorporation details |
| `公司行业划分表` | Industry classification mapping (primary/secondary industry names per company) |
| `公司主营业务构成` | Revenue and margin breakdown by business segment per reporting period |

Key Fields:
- `公司代码` — Internal company identifier; primary join key across most tables.
- `中文名称缩写` — Short Chinese company name; used as display label in results.
- `A股证券代码` — 6-digit A-share ticker (e.g., `'600234'`). Always stored and filtered as a string.
- `一级行业名称` — Primary industry classification name.
- `董事会秘书` / `董秘电话` — Board secretary name and phone; sourced from `公司概况`.

### 2.2 Equity Issuance & Capital Events

| Table | Business Purpose |
|-------|-----------------|
| `A股发行申报企业信息` | IPO application filings; includes industry/sector of applicant |
| `A股增发` | Secondary/additional share issuances (SEOs) with purpose and announcement dates |
| `A股配股` | Rights issues (配股) with year, target stock code, and funds raised |
| `股份回购` | Share buyback transactions with total repurchase amount and announcement date |
